title.zh: Anthropic 数学家称借助 Claude 证明黎曼猜想，Lean 社区确认证明正确
title.en: Anthropic claims a Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis; Lean community confirms it

summary.zh: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 称借助 Claude 证明了黎曼猜想，证明已用 Lean 形式化；Lean 与 Mathlib 社区经数十位独立验证者检查约 1700 万行代码后正式确认其正确。斯坦福同日发布了一份纯人工的竞争性草稿。
summary.en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, formalized in Lean. The Lean and Mathlib community confirmed it after dozens of independent verifiers checked about 17 million lines of code. Stanford released a competing all-human draft the same day.

why.zh: 若成立，这是 AI 参与解决数学最著名未解问题的标志性事件。
why.en: If it stands, it marks AI helping to settle math's most famous open problem.

sources.title: Lean and Mathlib community officially confirms Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct
Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft

title.zh: 研究：廉价 AI 推理服务商窃取密钥、窥探用户
title.en: Researchers: cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users

summary.zh: Dragos 安全研究员用 200 万次伪造请求探测 AI 供应链，发现至少 3 家被攻陷的服务商、数百个被盗的 AWS 密钥，并存在严重漏洞。
summary.en: Dragos researchers used two million fake AI requests to probe the AI supply chain, finding at least three compromised providers, hundreds of stolen AWS keys and serious vulnerabilities.

why.zh: 使用第三方低价推理中转的团队需要重新评估密钥与数据暴露风险。
why.en: Teams using cheap third-party inference relays should reassess key and data exposure.

sources.title: Security researchers show how cheap AI inference providers steal keys and snoop on users

title.zh: METR 警告：AI 进步快于专家评估其安全性的能力
title.en: METR warns AI is improving faster than experts can test its safety

summary.zh: METR 报告称 Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 等领先模型在研究类任务上进步迅速但越来越难测量，现有数据无法排除 AI 研发出现危险加速。
summary.en: METR reports that leading models like Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra are improving rapidly at research tasks but are harder to measure; current data cannot rule out a dangerous acceleration in AI development.

why.zh: 评估能力滞后会影响前沿模型的安全决策。
why.en: Lagging evaluation affects safety decisions for frontier models.

sources.title: AI is getting better faster than experts can reliably test whether new systems are safe, METR warns

title.zh: 新基准：AI 编码代理在模拟职场中完成任务不足十分之一
title.en: New benchmark: AI coding agents complete under 1 in 10 tasks in a simulated workplace

summary.zh: 新测试让 AI 编码代理在有同事、项目看板和不完整交接的模拟开发岗位中持续自主开发软件，它们在孤立测试中表现出色，但这类长程任务完成率不到十分之一。
summary.en: A new test places AI coding agents in a simulated developer job with colleagues, project boards and incomplete handoffs. They ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten such tasks.

why.zh: 提示孤立基准分数高估了代理的真实职场自主能力。
why.en: Suggests isolated benchmark scores overstate real-world agent autonomy.

sources.title: AI coding agents ace isolated tests but complete fewer than one in ten tasks in a simulated workplace

summary.en: The Verge talks with senior AI reporter Hayden Field about the Anthropic IPO in the third episode of its series, on whether the Claude lab can keep putting safety first after going public.

why.zh: 前沿实验室上市将影响其安全与商业之间的取舍。
why.en: A frontier lab going public shapes its trade-off between safety and commerce.

sources.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?

title.en: Perplexity launches Monitor API that turns web search into a nonstop watchdog

summary.zh: Perplexity 的 Monitor API 按计划搜索网页，仅在出现相关变化时通过 webhook 通知代理，并由其决策模型过滤不重要的结果。
summary.en: Perplexity's Monitor API searches the web on a schedule and alerts agents by webhook only when relevant changes occur, with its own decision model filtering unimportant results.

why.zh: 为代理提供事件驱动的信息获取方式，可直接接入工作流。
why.en: Gives agents event-driven information intake that plugs straight into workflows.

sources.title: Perplexity's new Monitor API turns web search from a one-off query into a nonstop watchdog

title.zh: GPT-6.2 Astra/Sol 回答更简短，但透明度评分低于 Claude
title.en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol answer more briefly but score lower on transparency than Claude

summary.zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol 回答更短更直接，但更不愿承认不确定性，Claude 模型在透明度上明显领先；OpenAI 同时发布了修正回答过短、多余追问和过度测试的提示模板。
summary.en: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give shorter, more direct answers but are less willing to admit uncertainty, with Claude well ahead on transparency. OpenAI also published prompt templates to fix overly brief answers, needless follow-up questions and excessive testing.

why.zh: 为选型和提示调优提供了可操作的对比与模板。
why.en: Offers a usable comparison and templates for model choice and prompt tuning.

sources.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol get to the point faster but score lower on transparency than Claude
OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions

title.zh: Nvidia 研究者：超大上下文窗口是死胡同
title.en: Nvidia researchers argue huge context windows are a dead end

summary.zh: Nvidia 研究者认为语言模型常常用不到完整上下文窗口，而长窗口慢、贵且易出错；他们提出的替代方案以定期摘要等方式在测试中表现更好。
summary.en: Nvidia researchers argue models often do not need their full context windows, which are slow, expensive and error-prone, and propose an alternative of periodic summaries that did well in tests.

why.zh: 可能改变长上下文与代理记忆的设计思路。
why.en: May shift design thinking on long context and agent memory.

sources.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end

title.zh: Signal 限制移动端截图，应对 AI 监控“生存威胁”
title.en: Signal restricts mobile screenshots amid AI surveillance "existential threat"

summary.zh: Signal 正在其 Android 与 iOS 应用中限制用户截屏能力。
summary.en: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.

why.zh: 反映 AI 监控对隐私应用设计的直接影响。
why.en: Shows AI surveillance directly shaping privacy-app design.

sources.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
